home.title: Course studio
home.subtitleAdmin: Every course made by staff. Edit, publish, or duplicate one to customise it.
home.subtitleInstructor: Write mini-courses for your classes, or let Pip draft one for you to edit.
home.emptyBody: Start from a topic and Pip drafts the lessons and activities. You can change everything after.
home.searchPlaceholder: Search by course name or 4-digit code, e.g. 5511
home.searchHint: Try part of the course name or the four-digit course code.
home.catalogSubtitle: Duplicate a published course to get your own private copy. The original stays as it is.
home.catalogEmptyBody: Published courses from other teachers show up here.

newCourse.title: New course
newCourse.subtitle: Tell Pip the topic and who it is for. You get a private draft to edit before anyone sees it.

generate.topicHint: One sentence is enough, e.g. “Writing user stories for a mobile app”.
generate.audienceNoteHint: Optional. e.g. “first-year business students who have never coded”.
generate.noActivityTypes: No activity types are installed yet, so the lessons will be reading only.
generate.materialsHint: Optional. Paste notes, a lecture outline or an article and Pip builds the course from it.
generate.requirementsHint: Optional. e.g. “include a role-play with a client” or “use examples from banking”.
generate.writingBody: Lessons first, then the activities. Keep this tab open.

course.summaryPlaceholder: Add a short summary so learners know what they will get.
course.demoNotice: This is demo content: no AI key is set up, so Pip used a sample course. Add an AI_API_KEY to generate a real one, or edit this draft by hand.
course.emptyLessonsBody: Add a lesson to start writing.
course.deleteLessonConfirm: Delete “{title}” and its activities? This cannot be undone.

meta.summaryHint: One or two sentences learners see on the course card.

publish.title: Publishing
publish.subtitle: Choose who can open this course.
publish.accessHint: Class access only makes the course available to classes you assign it to. After publishing, assign it in Classes → Courses. The public catalogue is visible to everyone and requires admin review.
publish.pendingNotice: Public request submitted. Waiting for an admin to review it.
publish.classNotAssigned: Class access is enabled, but this course is not assigned to any class yet. Students cannot see it until you assign it.
publish.archivedNotice: Archived. Publish it again to bring it back.
publish.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this public request? The course will return to draft and will not be reviewed.
publish.unpublishConfirm: This course is published in: {classes}. Unpublishing returns it to draft and removes it from all classes. Those students will lose access immediately. Continue?
publish.unpublishPublicConfirm: This course is in the public catalogue and visible to everyone. Unpublishing removes it from the catalogue and learners will lose access immediately. Continue?
publish.unpublishConfirmNoClasses: Unpublish this course? It will return to draft and learners will lose access immediately.
publish.archiveConfirm: Archive this course? Learners will no longer see it.
publish.courseLinkHint: Open it to see the course the way learners do.

lessonEditor.emptyBody: Learners finish a reading-only lesson by opening it. Add an activity below to let them practise.

lesson.textSubtitle: Markdown works: ## headings, **bold**, lists, tables and code.
lesson.acceptedNotice: Pip’s version is in the editor. Save the lesson to keep it.
lesson.previewEmpty: Start typing and the preview shows up here.

rewrite.title: AI rewrite
rewrite.subtitle: Pip rewrites the current text. Nothing changes until you use it.
rewrite.instructionHint: Pick a preset above or write your own.
rewrite.instructionPlaceholder: e.g. Use an example from a coffee shop

activity.heading: Activity {index} · {label}
activity.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}”? Learner results for it are deleted too.
activity.notInstalled: The “{type}” activity type is not installed, so it cannot be checked or previewed.
activity.setupHint: The preview updates as you type. Saving checks it against the activity type.
activity.fixJson: Fix the JSON to see the preview.

addActivity.title: Add an activity
addActivity.subtitle: Start blank and fill in the setup, or let Pip write one from this lesson’s text.
addActivity.emptyBody: Activity types are added in the activities registry. Once they are, they show up here.
addActivity.noteHint: Optional, used by “Generate with AI”. e.g. “focus on the difference between bugs and features”.

widget.subtitle: Your courses at a glance
widget.empty: No courses yet. Pip can draft your first one in about 30 seconds.

actions.notAllowed: You can only edit your own courses.
actions.generic: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.
actions.checkForm: Check the form and try again.
actions.aiGenerationFailed: Pip could not get a valid course from the model. Nothing was saved. Try again, or start with a blank course.
actions.topicTooShort: Tell Pip what the course is about (at least 3 characters).
actions.pickAtLeastOneType: Pick at least one activity type.
actions.courseTitleMin: Give the course a title (at least 3 characters).
actions.pickEmoji: Pick an emoji for the course.
actions.addLessonFirst: Add at least one lesson before publishing.
actions.onlyPublishedCanDuplicate: Only published courses you can see can be duplicated.
actions.maxLessons: A mini-course can have up to {max} lessons.
actions.onlyLesson: A course needs at least one lesson. Add another before deleting this one.
actions.minutesMin: A lesson takes at least 1 minute.
actions.contentTooLong: This lesson is very long. Split it into two lessons.
actions.rewriteInstructionMin: Pick a preset or say how Pip should rewrite it.
actions.rewriteContentEmpty: Write something first, then ask Pip to rewrite it.
actions.rewriteInstructionFallback: Say how Pip should rewrite it.
actions.rewriteDemo: Demo mode: no AI key is set up, so Pip returned the lesson unchanged.
actions.rewriteResult: Here is Pip’s version. Nothing changes until you use it and save.
actions.activityTypeNotInstalledSetup: The “{type}” activity type is not installed, so this setup cannot be checked.
actions.wholeXp: Use a whole number of XP.
actions.invalidJsonDetail: The setup is not valid JSON: {detail}
actions.setupMismatch:
The setup does not fit a {label}:
{issues}
actions.activityAddedDemo: Demo mode: no AI key is set up, so Pip added a sample {label}.
actions.activityAddedAi: Pip wrote a {label} from this lesson. Check it below.
actions.activityTypeMissing: That activity type is not installed.
actions.maxActivities: A lesson can have up to {max} activities.
actions.publishClassMessage: Published to your classes. Assign it to a class so learners can find it.
actions.submitPublicMessage: Sent for review. It shows up in the public catalog once an admin approves it.
actions.unpublishMessage: Back to draft. Learners cannot open it for now.
actions.archiveMessage: Archived. It is hidden from learners and the catalog.
